name: synth1
origin: An early result of this pipeline: a model rebuilt from AI-drawn photos, kept as the first test model.
what_it_is_good_for: Photos rendered from it (tests/render_synth.py) agree with each other exactly, so every photo check must pass; the reconstruction can be compared with the model itself (tests/face_truth.py).
known_traits: The face is flat: nose tip -0.3 mm from the bridge (luna 11.5 mm), because the pipeline that made it had no face relief yet.
Its texture shows a face with a nose, so MediaPipe marks a nose 13 mm high on a flat surface: a good test of that bias, not a typical face.
The arms and head are a silhouette hull: slab-like arms, no ears.
naming: Sets rendered from this pipeline's own results are numbered in the order they were frozen: synth1 (this file), synth2, ... A new one is added when the pipeline's results change in kind (e.g. a face with real relief); earlier ones stay, so numbers remain comparable. In code and older text 'synth' means synth1.
caution: A model made by this pipeline carries the pipeline's own mistakes. Thresholds calibrated only on it fit those mistakes; luna (an independent model, luna-source.json) is the reference for what a person looks like.
